name: anify
description: AI-driven DnD-style TRPG adventure orchestration for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Anify provides a GM AI and configurable character AI orchestration framework for running DnD-style TRPG adventures. It uses world books, campaign state, hidden quest frameworks, character memory templates, personality consistency checks, and a D20 MCP tool so checks are resolved outside the GM model.
